title: In-game chat, with tabs
description: Type to anyone mid-match: **All**, **Team**, or a private whisper. Every conversation gets its own tab, so two people talking at once no longer turn into one unreadable stream. Press **Enter** to write, **Tab** to switch.

title: Friends and party stay with you in a match
description: The social dock no longer disappears when a game starts — it moves to the bottom left, clear of the chat. Party members now show real online status instead of always reading as online.

title: The HUD finishes its redesign
description: The radial menu now matches the rest of the interface: dark plates, hairline seams, and one accent colour instead of six competing washes.

title: Come say hello on Discord
description: Find teammates, report bugs and hear about updates first. There is also a feedback button in the bottom-left corner — it works mid-match and carries the context we need.
